text:
Platinum Price in 2015
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2015, the LBMA platinum price fell 28.9% between 2015-01-30 ($1,221) and 2015-12-30 ($868). The highest sampled price was $1,221 in January and the lowest was $831 in November. The mean of these observations was $1,036. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
What happened in 2015:
A strong US dollar and expectations of Federal Reserve rate hikes pushed gold to multi-year lows.
